stdout.pattern:
usage: git2 cat-file (-t|-s|-e|-p|<type>) <object>

Display the content for the given object in the repository.

Options:
    -t
        display the type of the object
    -s
        display the size of the object
    -e
        displays nothing unless the object is corrupt
    -p
        pretty-print the object
    <type>
        the type of object to display
    <object>
        the object to display
